title: Act: Add admin round handlers, route wiring and scheduler start
summary: Implement rounds.go, NewWithScheduler and main wiring
description: Handler maps service errors to HTTP statuses; server builds the shared Service and routes.
acceptance_criteria: ErrNotFound->404, ErrIllegalTransition and ErrActiveRound->409, bad JSON->400
roundSource.Current uses the round FileStore latest round
technical_constraints: Handler depends on RoundService and ContributionLister interfaces

steps.symbol: new: RoundHandler (Create, Open, Close, Get, Contributions)
steps.action: Define RoundService{Create,Open,Close,Get} and ContributionLister{ListByRound}; RoundHandler methods decode JSON {world_id,starts_at,duration,base_release}, read chi param id and query world, call the service, write JSON, and map errors via a statusFor(err) helper (404/409/400/500)
steps.expected: Handlers return JSON with correct codes

steps.action: Rename body of New into NewWithScheduler(cfg,log) (http.Handler,*round.Scheduler) and make New call it returning only the handler; build round.FileStore and round.Service (Git: gitrepo.CLI, Contributions: contribution FileStore, DefaultDuration cfg.Round.Duration, DefaultBaseRelease cfg.Round.BaseRelease); register r.Route("/api/v1/admin") with r.Use(admin.Middleware(cfg.Admin.Token)) and the five round routes; change roundSource.Current to read the latest round from the round FileStore (by world) instead of world.Repo; build Scheduler with Worlds from world.Repo.List and time-based Clock
steps.expected: Admin routes protected; contributions see round.yaml status

steps.action: Call server.NewWithScheduler, start `go sched.Run(ctx)` with a signal.NotifyContext context, and pass the handler to http.ListenAndServe
